Resolves #19127
Related: #19126 · #15252

The film can show its rails now. A `rail` cue and `GestureDriver#executeRailStep` drive the whole round trip through real synthetic pointer input with the film cursor riding it: the pane's tab takes the pointer and then real focus (the header's contextual actions follow `containsFocus`, which no synthetic mouse event moves), the header's pin action folds the pane into its edge rail, the rail tab reveals it as an elevated pane, and the reveal's own pin brings it home. Every wait reads committed document truth (`autoHidden`, the home node's items) or the overlay's own state (`visible`, `revealPaneItemId`); the receipt carries `collapsed`, `revealed`, `restored`, the rail's `edge`, and the document before and after. The screenplay gains a `film-rails` scene between the return and the showcase — Metrics folds into the right rail and comes back to `right-top-tabs`, the strip that keeps Audit and Commits while it is away — with the budget pin moved 103 → 111 s and the vocabulary arm pinning the cue. No engine file changes.

Evidence: L3 (unit lifecycle controls plus a real headless continuous film replay on the seat's own Neural Link bridge, `NEO_NL_PORT` per #19066) → L3 required (AC-3). Residual: none for this leaf; the opening's reorder and the `native-return` cue stay with #19126, the take with #15252.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the pre-commit lint-staged hooks ran (secrets, whitespace, shorthand, jsdoc-types, ticket-archaeology, block-alignment, parse, class-module-scope, fixed-sleeps, engine-brain-boundary).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered + outside-CI: `GestureDriver.spec.mjs` › "focus, fold, reveal and pin back arrive as clicks in that order, and the document round-trips" — four clicks in order on the tab, the pin action, the rail tab and the reveal's pin, `{collapsed, revealed, restored, edge: 'right'}` in the receipt, no run left active; the film replay's rail receipt carries the same three phases on the real rail (`edge: 'right'`). Restated from the ticket: the beat's claim is the pane home in its own node; the round trip's byte-identity is reported in the receipt (`documentsUnchanged`), not required, because the pin back is allowed to leave `pinned` or the active item different from the moment before the fold |
| AC-2 | CI-covered, three negative controls in `GestureDriver.spec.mjs`, each starting from a committed fold: "a rail that never grows the tab fails by name and brings the pane home through the document, not the pointer" (`the rail never showed a tab for 'metrics'`, two clicks only, then `setItemAutoHidden: false` through the workspace and the pane back in its node), "destruction while a reveal is genuinely open dismisses it through its owner, keeps the fold and clicks no late pin" (the overlay is asserted visible before `destroy()`; the settle calls the rail's `revealMachine.escape()`, the overlay reads hidden, the fold stays because the rail tab exists, no pin click, the service retired once the run settled, the workspace intact) and "a reveal without a pin action fails by name, is dismissed through its owner, and the fold stays"; a fourth control, "destruction after the fold committed but before the executor read it still brings the pane home", destroys the driver inside the pin click's own dispatch right after the fold committed, so the executor's trap rejects with its local flag unassigned — the settle awaits the input in flight, reads the fold from the live document and brings the pane home. The visible-reveal arm runs with the film cursor and asserts its retirement and a balanced pointer. The settle (`GestureDriver#settleRailFold`) borrows the run's workspace and polls on a plain timer, so it runs after the driver's destruction retired its config and its timeouts |
| AC-3 | outside-CI: `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT=<brain> NEO_NL_PORT=8093 npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationFilmTourNL.spec.mjs -g "under autoGates"` at this head — 1 of 1 passed (1.1 min): the continuous journey through the morph, the committed birth, the second window, the return, the rail round trip (`collapsed`/`revealed`/`restored`, `edge: 'right'`), the showcase, perspectives and undo/redo; the scene's budget is 8 s with one 800 ms pause and a 1.2 s reveal dwell |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `fiveBeatFilm.spec.mjs` — the scene order carries `film-rails` after `film-reintegration`, the cue list equals `filmCueTypes` with `rail`, the pin reads 111 s inside the envelope |

## Deltas from ticket
- AC-1's "round-tripped byte-identical" is restated as above: measured on the real rail, the beat's truth is the pane's return to its home node; byte-identity is a reported fact the cut may read, not a gate.
- Two replay reds fixed before this head, both in the executor: the pin action's first geometry read came back empty (it is mounted a frame after focus — the read now polls), and synthetic clicks never moved focus at all, so the focus-gated action was never mounted — the tab now takes real focus by name (`button.focus()`) after the pointer click, and the wait reads `containsFocus`.
- Review R1 (Euclid): a fold that committed and then failed left the pane folded away or its reveal open; the executor's early returns and its catch retired only the cursor, and the destruction arm hid the overlay itself before destroying the driver. Every failed exit after the fold now settles through the owners (`ebcf46b7fc`). His second pass named the window between the pin click's trap rejecting on destruction and the input receipt still committing the fold: the settle now awaits the input in flight and reads the fold from the live document (`39676b751a`).

- Headless film replay: 1 of 1 passed (1.1 min) at `a10f6c2418` after the two executor repairs above (red on the first geometry read; red on focus); 1 of 1 passed (1.1 min) again at `ebcf46b7fc`, with the rail beat's receipt (`auto beat 16/28: the pin folds Metrics into the right rail; the rail tab reveals it; the reveal's pin brings it home`) on the real rail; 1 of 1 passed (1.1 min) at `39676b751a` with the same rail receipt.
- Not in CI: the film witness is a Neural Link spec; the unit arms are CI-covered.
